page_title: MNT 2-2 STR | Montpellier v Strasbourg 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Stephanie Frappart has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
90+2' Here is a change. Emanuel Emegha is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg).
90+1' Substitution. Rabby Inzingoula (Strasbourg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Thomas Delaine walks off.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

87' Referee Stephanie Frappart signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Montpellier players have a reason to celebrate! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
87' Montpellier score a goal, but referee Stephanie Frappart has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
86' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play. Montpellier are awarded a corner kick.
84' It's like he was asking for a caution. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) receives a yellow card.
83' 1 - 2 GOAL! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Benjamin Lecomte, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:2.
82' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
80' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yann Karamoh (Montpellier) replacing Akor Adams.
79' Great save! Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Alaa Bellaarouch.
78' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) will replace Marvin Senaya.
74' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) commits a foul and Stephanie Frappart immediately signals a free kick.
71' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
70' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
70' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
68' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) replaces Joris Chotard.
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) for Mousa Al-Tamari.
68' A long pass, executed by Akor Adams (Montpellier), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
66' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
64' Akor Adams (Montpellier) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch is prepared to thwart his effort.
62' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but Alaa Bellaarouch comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' That's the end of the game for Dilane Bakwa, who is replaced by Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
55' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
54' Referee Stephanie Frappart sees the trip by Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg).
47' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Benjamin Lecomte no chance!
47' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
47' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) trips an opposition player and Stephanie Frappart signals a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Strasbourg are awarded a penalty kick!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

45+2' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Montpellier will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' The resulting corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
40' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Akor Adams (Montpellier) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
36' Akor Adams (Montpellier) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
34' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
33' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
32' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
31' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Alaa Bellaarouch was alert and made a comfortable save.
30' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
29' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) will take the corner.
28' A dangerous looking corner kick from Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is cleared to safety by the defence.

27' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) won himself just enough space to connect with the corner inside the box. His header flew towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dived superbly to stop the effort. Strasbourg have a corner.
27' Corner kick. Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) is ready to send the ball into the box.
26' Junior Mwanga (Strasbourg) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Benjamin Lecomte acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save! Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Akor Adams (Montpellier) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Alaa Bellaarouch easily deals with the threat.
19' The referee is firm and issues Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) a deserved yellow card.
18' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) brings an opponent down and Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game.
17' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) prepares to take a corner kick.
17' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. Strasbourg get a corner.
15' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
14' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) will take a corner kick.
14' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alaa Bellaarouch, who smothers the ball.
11' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
9' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) is first to arrive to a high rebound just outside the box and attempts to score with a header, but the keeper blocks it.
5' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
4' Montpellier earn a corner.
3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
3' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Montpellier force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
2' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
